mapper.sql: CONFIG_ID, CONFIG_KEY, CONFIG_NAME, CONFIG_VALUE, DEFAULT_VALUE, CONFIG_TYPE, CONFIG_GROUP, CONFIG_DESCRIPTION, ENABLED, SYSTEM_FLAG, SORT_ORDER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM SYS_CONFIG
ORDER BY CONFIG_GROUP ASC, SORT_ORDER ASC, CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT CONFIG_VALUE FROM SYS_CONFIG WHERE CONFIG_KEY = #{configKey} AND ENABLED = 1
SELECT FROM SYS_CONFIG WHERE CONFIG_GROUP = #{configGroup} AND ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_CONFIG WHERE CONFIG_TYPE = #{configType} AND ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY CONFIG_GROUP ASC, SORT_ORDER ASC, CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_CONFIG WHERE ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY CONFIG_GROUP ASC, SORT_ORDER ASC, CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_CONFIG WHERE SYSTEM_FLAG = 1 ORDER BY CONFIG_GROUP ASC, SORT_ORDER ASC, CREATE_TIME DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE SYS_CONFIG SET ENABLED = #{enabled}, UPDATE_TIME =
NOW() SYSDATE NOW()
WHERE CONFIG_ID IN
#{configId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM SYS_CONFIG WHERE CONFIG_GROUP = 'DATA_COLLECTION' AND ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_CONFIG WHERE CONFIG_GROUP = 'NOTIFICATION' AND ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_CONFIG WHERE CONFIG_GROUP = 'REPORT' AND ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM SYS_CONFIG WHERE CONFIG_GROUP = 'INTEGRATION' AND ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalConfigs, COUNT(CASE WHEN ENABLED = 1 THEN 1 END) as enabledConfigs, COUNT(CASE WHEN ENABLED = 0 THEN 1 END) as disabledConfigs, COUNT(CASE WHEN SYSTEM_FLAG = 1 THEN 1 END) as systemConfigs, COUNT(CASE WHEN SYSTEM_FLAG = 0 THEN 1 END) as businessConfigs, COUNT(DISTINCT CONFIG_GROUP) as groupCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CONFIG_TYPE) as typeCount FROM SYS_CONFIG

SELECT CONFIG_GROUP as configGroup, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN ENABLED = 1 THEN 1 END) as enabledCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ENABLED = 0 THEN 1 END) as disabledCount, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_CONFIG), 2) as percentage FROM SYS_CONFIG GROUP BY CONFIG_GROUP ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CONFIG_TYPE as configType, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(CASE WHEN ENABLED = 1 THEN 1 END) as enabledCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ENABLED = 0 THEN 1 END) as disabledCount, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS_CONFIG), 2) as percentage FROM SYS_CONFIG GROUP BY CONFIG_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT FROM SYS_CONFIG
ORDER BY CONFIG_GROUP ASC, SORT_ORDER ASC, CREATE_TIME DESC
